suggestion.title: Draft replies to your remaining unread emails?
suggestion.why: You drafted replies to 2 emails the same way in the last few minutes.

widget.name: Draft Replies
plan: Strategy: DOM automation, because no network operations were captured on this page.
Add a 'Draft replies' button (plus a 'Skip newsletters' option) to the HardMail main toolbar.
On click, go back to the inbox and note a stable key for every unread or selected email up front, since rows change as they are read.
For each email: re-find its row, open the thread, and read the subject, sender and body.
Open the reply composer (clicking Reply if needed), have WidgetAI.inference write a short reply in your style, insert it, and wait for 'Draft saved'.
Show a per-email summary of saved, unverified, skipped and failed drafts. Nothing is ever sent.
